component.name: Lai Siangtho
component.summary: Read and study the Bible, offline

description.p: Lai Siangtho is a Bible to read and to work in. Translations are downloaded once and kept on the device, read side by side in their own scripts and languages, with no account and nothing uploaded.

ul.li: Parallel reading, levelled verse by verse, with synchronised scrolling
Search that counts every match, with whole words and regular expressions
Notes, bookmarks, tags, reading plans, memory verses and study projects that belong to the passage, not to one translation
Strong's numbers, a lexicon, word study and an interlinear line from Hebrew and Greek texts the reader imports
Translations from the Lai Siangtho catalog, getBible, eBible.org or a file in USFM, USX, USFX, OSIS, Zefania or browserBible form
Verse cards, printable sheets and exports to every format it reads
